title: Nothing was sacrificed until the spell resolved
era: 1994 Old School model with current Oracle wording
matchup: Nested Draw Control against mono-blue control
story: Two blue sources, Tundra and Tropical Island , paid for my Transmute Artifact . I left Sol Ring on the battlefield while the sorcery waited on the stack. My opponent could have countered it without forcing a sacrifice, but they let it resolve. Only then did I sacrifice Sol Ring and search my library for Mana Vault , another artifact with mana value one. Vault entered the battlefield without an additional payment, and I shuffled. I had not paid a sacrifice cost while casting the spell, and Vault had entered without being cast, so there was no separate artifact spell on the stack.
review: Original 1994 era represented with modern Oracle wording; Transmute Artifact sacrifice is an EFFECT of spell resolution, not an additional cost; Counterspell before resolution leaves original artifact intact. Sacrifice MV1 Sol Ring, find MV1 Mana Vault, no difference; Tundra and Tropical Island each blue pay UU. Groundhog Day archive curated.
